method: Static reference frames plus numerical traces; no raw playback and no external PEAT adjudication.

broadcast_context.context: Rapid squirrel close-up movement against a bright background.
Moving squirrel and leaves against bright sky and spikes.
Moving foliage and a squirrel over the spikes.
Dense white-on-black credits with an animated squirrel.

conclusion: The flags coincide with high-contrast motion, foliage and credits, rather than an assumed clean zero-flash source. The detector measures cell luminance reversals, so motion can create qualifying excursions. These are candidate motion/text false alarms; they have not been adjudicated as confirmed false alarms or true broadcast violations. Local and Kids add smaller-area/lower-count detections and remain unadjudicated. No natural-film accuracy score or zero-false-alarm claim is justified.
